spec.name: Furniture Hanging Bat Mobile
spec.description: Three upside-down charcoal bats with tucked plum wings and tiny painted amber eyes hang at staggered heights from a dark oak crossbar. Two short ceiling ties reach y=15.75. Entirely suspended, with connected construction and individually mapped pixel-art surfaces.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: ceiling-hung mobile of three upside-down black bats with tucked purple wings and tiny amber eyes, suspended from a thin dark wooden crossbar and cords; no floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Ceiling attachment: suspension points reach y=15.75, artwork hanging below. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
